title: Agent Certificate v0 MeasurementContract Registry Record
description: The MINIMAL blinded commitment record for MeasurementContract registration in the certificate program (C1 Ruling 3, 'Corrected MeasurementContractV0 boundary allowlist', binding): fixed schema discriminator · server-assigned opaque contract ID (response only) · commitment/canonicalization scheme enums · blinded commitment to the COMPLETE client-local measurement contract · server-computed canonical record digest. 'Metric IDs, dataset size, split policy, seed, and decision-rule details remain inside the committed client-local document unless a concrete server function requires them' — none of those fields is representable here, and NO counts or date buckets cross (struck by C1). PRINTED NON-CLAIMS (required at registration): 'No execution, representativeness, preregistration timing, effect, winner, stability, or statistical validity is established' by registration; statistical claims 'remain suspended' (binding P0 — E2 is a mandatory printed non-claim on every certificate); 'Fresh-blinding re-registration and semantic duplicates are not prevented'; 'Registration does not establish that the server lacks the preimage through another channel'; ''Printed at registration' is target behavior, not shipped evidence.' Reversal condition: 'admit a structured field only when a named consumer cannot operate on the commitment alone and its disclosure cost is explicitly approved.' This is a DIFFERENT record family from agent_lifecycle_record/'s ALR-1106 registration routes — the certificate-boundary commitment shape, not a replacement for them. Root instance is one registered record (the response shape); the request shape is #/definitions/RegisterRequestV0.

RegisterRequestV0.description: Create-once registration request: scheme enums plus the secret-blinded commitment to the complete client-local measurement contract. No metric IDs, dataset sizes, split policies, seeds, counts, date buckets, or free text are representable.

blinded_contract_commitment.description: Secret-blinded commitment to the complete client-local measurement contract document. Blinding material stays client-local; a public salt would not prevent low-entropy guessing (merged prohibited claim 22).

MeasurementContractRegistryRecordV0.description: The immutable registered record (create-once/get-by-ID). canonical_record_digest is server-computed over the canonical RegisterRequestV0 record BEFORE contract_id assignment, excluding the assigned ID. No timestamp field exists: precise timestamps remain server-internal and date buckets are struck.

contract_id.description: Server-assigned opaque contract ID (response only; never client-supplied).

canonical_record_digest.description: Server-computed canonical digest over the request record before ID assignment ('excluding the assigned ID' — including it would be circular).
